_doc: THE NEWS TAB'S DECLARED BEHAVIOUR (Perplexity Discover-style). backend: the fleet's news-gdelt service (cloud-u-containers user-news_news-gdelt): GET {base}/articles?q=<query>&limit=<n> returns {query,count,articles:[{url,title,seendate,socialimage,domain,language,sourcecountry,tone}]} from a GDELT cache; {base} is the fleet_endpoints `news` entry (ac_cloud-account/build.json): the mesh base first, then the public base with the fleet bearer, baked as BuildConfig.NEWS_MESH_URL / NEWS_PUBLIC_URL. It has no summaries, so the card and story summaries are written by the AI gateway from the fetched headlines only, and shown as AI summaries; no story is ever invented, and an unreachable backend shows an empty state. topics: id (also the build.json::ui page id), label, icon, queries (GDELT queries; a feed merges them). 'foryou' merges the topics listed in mix. cluster_similarity: headlines whose word overlap reaches it are one story, its sources count the distinct domains.
